lines.t: (Intro)
Before the silence learned to breathe,
Before the depths conceived the seas,
You stood beyond both time and frame,
And called creation by its name.
(Verse 1)
You traced the light across the void,
Where nothing lived, Your voice deployed.
You shaped the hills, You formed the flame,
And every star obeyed Your name.
Still in all Your vast design,
You drew a fragile heart like mine.
(Pre-Chorus)
The voice that set the worlds in place,
Still whispers close with endless grace.
(Chorus)
You spoke and worlds began to wake,
Colors formed in heaven’s wake.
Every ocean, every land,
Crafted by Your steady hand.
Yet in all Your majesty,
You are near, You walk with me.
YahuShua, You call me home,
Closer than the stars You roll.
Closer than the stars You roll.
(Verse 2)
You formed the dust and called it life,
Wrote the end and start of time.
Every breath and every beat,
Moves in rhythm at Your feet.
And You saw it all was right,
Bathed in mercy, crowned in light.
(Pre-Chorus 2)
I don’t have to earn Your gaze,
I am known within Your ways.
(Chorus)
You spoke and worlds began to wake,
Filled the dark no night could take.
Every valley, every flame,
Echoes out Your holy name.
And the life You gave to me,
Flows from Your eternity.
YahuShua, my heart will stay,
Resting in the words You say.
(Bridge)
From the first breath to the end,
All creation will ascend.
Every sky and every sea,
Sings in perfect harmony.
(Build)
And in the quiet I can feel,
Every promise You reveal—
(Drop)
A living sound… a sacred thread,
By Your voice, all life is led.
(Final Chorus)
You spoke and time began to move,
Set the stars in perfect groove.
Every heartbeat, every soul,
Held within Your sovereign hold.
And the One who shaped the skies,
Sees the tears within my eyes.
YahuShua, my life will be,
A reflection of Your peace.
(Outro)
Let the winds declare Your name,
Let the fire and rain proclaim.
In the wonder I can see,
The hand that formed eternity…
Is still restoring me.
